description: This file defines APIs and data structures for managing DNS-related objects within the COSA Data Model library, including client configurations, server settings, relay options, forwarding rules, and diagnostics including NSLookup diagnostics.

methods.name: Client1_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for DNS client configuration.

methods.name: Client1_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for DNS client configuration.

methods.name: Server1_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of DNS server entries.

methods.name: Server1_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new DNS server entry.

methods.name: Relay_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for DNS relay configuration.

methods.name: Forwarding_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of forwarding rules.

methods.name: NSLookupDiagnostics_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for DNS NSLookup diagnostics.
